### T-486 — Purge a feedback session from the Playwright run

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · open_

test/feedback.play.ts submits a real session and marks it processed, so a UI run leaves one row, its
items and its picture behind, while the tap flow cleans up after itself. Add a dev-only handler
(adapter/dbTest) that deletes a session with its items and shot, reachable from the spec, and call
it in the spec's teardown. Until then a repeated UI run grows the database by one processed session
per run.

### T-455 — Write the feedback session, item and shot schema

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

Add the three tables of plan section 5 to meta/type/schema.ts, register them in meta/db/db.ts above
core order and seed the feedback.session alias in meta/db/0-feedbackTypeMerge.yaml, with no prose
column on the session. Verify a dev start creates the tables and that shotData comes out as
longtext. Plan sections 5 and 5.4.

Three tables in meta/type/schema.ts, registered at order 400-402 in meta/db/db.ts; the alias seed is
meta/db/0-coreTypeMerge.yaml (the plan said 0-feedbackTypeMerge, but the file name derives the seed
method and must be coreTypeMerge to write core.type). Verified on blong-feedback:
feedback_shot.shotData is longtext, feedback_session holds the two dbTest sessions. Two corrections
found while verifying: targetId is maxLength 255, not 512, because MySQL refuses a unique index on a
TEXT column without a prefix length; seed datetimes are 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', not ISO with T and Z.

### T-458 — Seed the RBAC grants for submit and review

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

in the realm production seed with replace true, and the same capability for the test roles. Verify a

feedback.session.add joined loginCapability in
realm/blong-access/meta/db/accessAuthorizationMerge.yaml, so every role that may log in may leave

Capability entries are dotted called-method names, because gateway.authorize compares the route
asked for. Verified by inspection of the seeds; the 403/200 behaviour is asserted in T-477.

### T-469 — Persist a feedback session, its items and its shot

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

feedbackSessionAdd writes the three rows in one transaction, stamps the submitter from the meta,
enforces the limits and stores no document. Test three items, one shot and status new. Plan sections
5 and 6.

feedback.session.add writes the session (through super.coreResourceEnsure, so the core_resource row
is created in the same transaction), its items and its shot in one knex transaction; the submitter
is stamped from $meta.auth.actorId and nothing is rendered or stored. Proven by the tap flow: three
items, one shot, status new, then cleanup. Found and fixed two framework facts on the way: error
params must be nested under {params: ...} for interpolation, and knex refuses a Buffer inside a
where-object.

### T-470 — Render the feedback prose from a batch of sessions

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

adapter/db/prose.ts renders one Markdown document for a selection, preferring refinedText over
commentText, with a heading per item and a trailing block of target ids. Golden test over two
sessions. Plan section 6 and D-660.

adapter/db/prose.ts is a library() binding exposing renderProse(entries): one document for a batch,
a heading per item with its target id and label, the wording quoted (refinedText preferred over
commentText), a trailing text block of every target id, and a version marker (blong-feedback v1).
The tap flow asserts the identifiers, their order and the verbatim quote, and that a refinement
replaces the original on the next render.

### T-471 — Add the processed mark, the item edit and the readers

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

feedbackSessionUpdate marks a batch processed with the reviewer and the time, feedbackItemEdit
stores the clarification, feedbackShotGet returns the data URL and feedbackSessionProseRender
renders without writing. Test each. Plan sections 6 and 6.1 and D-663.

feedbackSessionUpdate marks a batch processed with the reviewer and the time; feedbackItemEdit
stores a clarification after checking the item belongs to the session; feedbackShotGet returns the
data URL or the typed feedback.shotMissing. feedbackSessionItems was added because the generic get
cannot read a uid key (it normalises to a Buffer and knex refuses it in a where-object) — it returns
the session plus its items with ULID ids and parsed anchors, which the review page will also use.
feedbackSessionProseRender renders a selection ({sessionIds} or {status}) and applies an optional
config.prose.polish through the handler proxy without writing. All asserted by the 7-step tap flow.

Gateway wrappers in realm/blong-feedback/gateway/feedback for add, find, get, items, update,

### T-477 — Test the feedback flow with tap

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

Add, batch render, bulk processed mark, item edit, shot read, permission refusal and the expected
errors with meta expect, wired into integration.watch.test. Plan section 8.

server/test/test/testFeedbackFlow.ts wires test.feedback.flow into integration.watch.test;
index.test.ts is now server-only (the scaffold browser platform and its test folder were removed).
Seven steps pass against the dev database: add (3 items + shot), render (identifiers, order,
verbatim quote, version), refine, re-render (refinement wins), mark processed (and the session
leaves the new queue), shot read (data URL, mimeType) plus a refused unknown session, and cleanup
that removes shot, items and session.

### T-479 — Silence the expected errors and keep the database clean

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

Declare meta expect for the refusals the flows assert and make sure no spec leaves a feedback row
behind. Plan section 8.

The flow asserts the only expected refusal directly (assert.rejects on feedback.shotMissing for an
unknown session), and its last step deletes the shot, the items and the session it created, so a run
on every save leaves the database as it found it. The two seeded dbTest sessions are left alone and
are what the review page story will show.

### T-473 — Build the admin review page

> _2026-10-28 · realm/blong-feedback · done_

A two-pane page with the unprocessed queue, per-item editors, the screenshot with anchors, the
rendered document with copy and the processed mark, registered through a component handler and a
portal menu entry. Verify by submitting and reviewing. Plan section 6.2.

src/pages/feedbackReviewPage.tsx is the two-pane review UI: a status filter and checkbox queue on
the left, the picked session's screenshot with its anchors scaled by the captured width, one editor
per comment that saves a clarification on blur, and a bottom pane that renders the document for the
selection with Copy and marks the same selection processed. Registered by
component/feedbackReview.ts as feedback.review with permission feedback.session.find, and linked
from component/feedback.portal.ts. Two readers were added to make it possible: feedback.session.list
(newest first with item counts) and feedback.session.items (session plus items with ULID ids and
parsed anchors). Realm type-check and lint clean; the tap flow still passes.
